additional_info.subject: RE: ID0415598-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RN 313392372011] DC1_StateMonitor_KF13 CRM:00796001474
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Emre,
I hope you are doing well.
Regarding the reported issue, we have inspected the charger on SCB and identified some anomalies with the DC1_StateMonitor_KF14 and DC2_StateMonitor_KF14. Therefore, we recommend a site visit to troubleshoot the StateMonitor_KF14, as the schematic nomenclature differs from the respective SCB error flags.
Please follow the steps provided in the attached document and refer to the points below:
Check the areas marked in red for possible loose wiring.
If all the wiring is secure and configuration is ok, then need to be replace but check all the connections of the KF14 module before considering its replacement
Kindly refer the below KA for the reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SiCD_HW_KF13_ DC1_StateMonitor_KF13 error - Dynamics 365
And please carry a spare
KF13/14 module
and the
contactors
used in the fast shutdown system.
Please confirm based on the configuration.
Contactors 4Qty-: 3RQ3018-2AM08-0AA0
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
